title: Dating the Silver Leaf years and when Perez left for Chicago
summary: Allen presses for exact dates; Charles says Silver Leaf ran 1912-16 and Perez's ticket came after he was married.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: I wanted to ask you, to get back to mind with the rest, you say he left and went to Chicago.
Were you playing with a band when he left? Oh yeah I was playing with the Silver Leaf band.
With the Silver Leaf band. And so you joined in what year?
The Silver Leaf band, we had the Silver Leaf band, from 1912 up until 1916.
About how long had you been playing with them when Manuel left?
How long I was playing with the Silver Leaf band? From 1912 to 16.

No, when Manuel left how long had you been with the band? See what I mean? Did Manuel play with the band all the time you were there? No, no, no. What I'm trying to get at is when Manuel left? What year he left, you see?

Well it must be 1916 because that's the time that, maybe later than that. Because when he wanted me to go and play with that band I'm telling you about, in Seattle, Washington, read that band in Seattle, Washington, he sent me that ticket. But I had got married then, you see? So I didn't want to go. So it had to be a little later that you had
that offer to leave. That's right. I see. I just want to try to get an exact date on these things. You see what I'm getting at? Oh, that's right. I might see.
